Forty Foes is coming along! 
still 4 players local, but there are now 9 playable characters rather than 6 :)
players are divided into 3 classes (Think mario kart)

Heavy, mid and small. 
The Heavys are 
Lazarus Gold 
Armored Dillo 
& Abobette 


Mids are
 Rye FireBlood
 Zven Wiles & 
Duke VonGarland of[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2582300/VonGarland_Castle__Sacrilege_of_the_Night/] VonGarland Castle[/url]
 
Smalls are
 Toadumas 
Sinnobre and 
Latach & kei 
(Latach & kei  are two characters in one like Ice Climbers )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44060471/8762d0dc21e40ea100d07563c8447a775151e73f.png[/img]

Along with your Kicks/punches chops and slashes you can Block Enemies when you have block HP, this keeps you from taking damage and knocks attacking enemies back slightly. you can also Guard attacks if you time it right, this boosts you attack power for a limited time, you can max out you Atk up power to +5

I'll have more to show and talk about soon!
please be sure to follow & wishlist and tell your pals. 
and feel free to post questions and comments and I'll be sure to get back to them soon 


Thanks so much for reading 
-Ash 
Monster Robot Studios
